title: Anyway JOIN refinements — round 03
purpose: Four controlled refinements of direction 26, each displayed as a large specimen and in the user's website header.

variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Make ONE polished design review image for ONE variation of an approved wordmark, with the variation applied in the actual website header.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is a wordmark style reference. ONLY the MIDDLE concept labeled "26 / JOIN" is approved. Ignore concepts 25 and 27 completely. Image 2 is the user's real website and is the source of the website header and its appearance.
Approved direction: lowercase "anyway", six letters a-n-y-w-a-y, bold custom geometric sans, circular single-storey a characters, circular n shoulder, precise flat terminals, and a memorable sharp diagonal y-w construction. White on charcoal. Remain visibly in this exact family; this is a careful refinement of concept 26, not a new style search. All letters must remain immediately readable. No italic, serif, handwriting, bubble letters, icons, symbols or underlines.

OUTPUT: A wide LANDSCAPE presentation with roughly 3:2 aspect ratio. Restrained, clear, beautifully spaced.
At top left a small muted neutral label with the exact variant name given below.
The UPPER 48% is a plain dark charcoal specimen area, with the new white wordmark centered large enough to examine the custom joins and letter shapes, about 55% of the image width. No other artwork.
The LOWER 52% is an accurate crop of the user's real website from Image 2, spanning its full width: include its complete real navigation header, the surrounding charcoal background and a shallow portion of the hero beneath, so this clearly feels like their real website. Keep the screenshot's original spacing, search field, "docs" styling, slash separator, right-side GitHub link, and dark theme. Replace ONLY the handwritten Anyway wordmark in the top-left with THIS exact new variant, at a comfortable equivalent width (roughly 180px in the original 2238px screenshot) and about 32px visual letter height; make it visually balanced with the adjacent docs label. Do not add floating cards, frames, or rearranged UI. Preserve the screenshot's generous horizontal gutters and original alignment. The logo in the website header MUST MATCH the large specimen above, including the precise y-w connection, weight, case, and terminals.
Separate specimen and website subtly with one thin dark-gray horizontal rule. No extra explanatory text or diagrams, no arbitrary repeated logos, no texture in specimen, no 3D or mockup perspective. The website remains faithful to Image 2 except for replacing the logo. The screenshot text, where visible, remains unchanged.

Variant label: "26A / BALANCED".
Make the closest refined version of original 26. Keep its generous round single-storey a bowls, almost circular n shoulder, firm substantial weight and sharp diagonal y-w relation. Improve the optical kerning slightly: even negative spaces from a-n through w-a-y; leave a fine clear diagonal channel so y and w don't become an ambiguous blob. Both y letters have the same straight, clean descending terminal and coherent angle. Keep the original angular w's distinctive center construction. Only subtle optical improvements; the original approved identity should be unmistakable.

Softer in feel but still precise and geometric; no puffy gummy letterforms. This should be immediately recognizable as the same logo with a more tactile finish.

Start from approved 26 and change ONLY the central y-w relationship: make the two letters work as a clear intentional custom ligature, using a precisely aligned shared diagonal rhythm and one fine white-space separation.
